'''Malaryan''' (Mala Arayan, Malayarayar, {{ipa|mjq|mɐlɐrjɐn|ipa}}) is an [[Extinct language|extinct]] [[Dravidian language]] of [[Kerala]] and [[Tamil Nadu]] that was closely related to [[Malayalam]].
